messages:
Lina (marketing): Need a micro-battlecard + 2-slide webinar hook focused on competitive messaging vs cloud AI endpoints, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. Keep it tight.
Carlos (sales): Field asks: surprise bills, p99 spikes, lock-in. Need one-line counters and a demo hook.
Eve (product): Structure: claim (1 line), why it matters (1 line), demo hook (1 line). Add one technical footnote for SREs.
Nikhil (eng): Bench note: internal dialog bench shows ~2x median token spend reduction with prefix KV cache + batching vs a major cloud endpoint; p95/p99 vary by region. Add "lab results" caveat.
Lina (marketing): Draft hero options:
 - "Fix inference economics, keep your models."
 - "Lower bills. Predictable latency. Same models."
Carlos (sales): Rebut snippet examples:
 - Obj: "We're on CloudZ already."
   Reply: "CloudZ is great for dev; in prod you can hit opaque bills and tail latency. Redwood adds routing, caching, and fallbacks so costs and SLOs are predictable."
 - Obj: "Migration is hard."
   Reply: "Start with the API as a drop-in and enable routing/caching incrementally; Private installs available for lift-and-shift."
Eve (product): SRE line: "Continuous coalescing, per-session KV prefix reuse, and model-variant routing reduce repeated compute while preserving median latency."
Nikhil (eng): Demo routing snippet for slide:
```json
{"policy":"cost-aware","primary":"llama-70b","fallbacks":["llama-13b-quant"],"kv_cache":true,"batch_ms":10}
```
Lina (marketing): Inbound routing rules (simple): keywords->AE: "SLA|on-prem|private|dedicated|compliance"; keywords->SDR: "trial|signup|api key|embed|free credits"; score>=80->AE,50-79->SDR,<50->drip. Regex: `/\\b(SLA|on-?prem|private|dedicated|compliance)\\b/i`.
asset-bot: Created asset stub https://internal.redwood/marketing/assets/inbound-route-battlecard (permissions: marketing-edit).
Carlos (sales): I'll add two roleplay lines after Lina posts the one-pager.
Lina (marketing): Thanks team  aiming to freeze copy by EOD tomorrow so design can mock slides.
